clips.title:
What a failing septic
drain field *really* costs to fix

youtube.title: What does it cost to rejuvenate a failing septic drain field? About $5,000

captions.instagram:
A failing drain field doesn't always mean a new system.

I asked Stephen Moeller of {riovation} what the cost looks like. Every state is a little different, some require permitting, you need a riser to the surface if there isn't one, and the tank gets pumped. All in, he says it's usually in the $5,000 range. Replacing a system that maybe doesn't need to be replaced is quite a bit different. Agree?

Full episode: {episode}

#septic #drainfield #septicbusiness #wastewater #septicowner
captions.facebook:
Someone told me about their area last night: very rural, a lot of older people on fixed incomes, and systems backing up and failing. Then they're looking at a $20,000, $30,000 or $50,000 bill for a whole new system. So I asked Stephen Moeller of RioVation what drain field rejuvenation costs. His answer: usually in the $5,000 range, depending on your state, permitting, a riser and pumping the tank. It would not work in every case, but it's a conversation worth having before anyone signs for a new system.

clips.title:
How a *septic* tank in Liberia
lost its odor on day one

youtube.title: How a septic tank in Liberia lost its odor on day one

captions.instagram:
The odor was gone on day one.

A customer in Liberia with 8,000 gallons a day of flow had an anaerobic tank, a trickle filter and a community that kept complaining about the smell. Stephen Moeller of {riovation} says they pumped the tank, installed the product, and the odor was gone right away. Anaerobic microorganisms off-gas hydrogen sulfide. Aerobic microorganisms off-gas carbon dioxide. Have you ever fixed an odor problem that fast?

Imagine a facility in Liberia where the whole community around it is constantly complaining about the smell.
